description: This is a SwiftUI view source file defining the RootCanvas component, which manages the main UI flow, onboarding, gateway connection status, and user interactions in the application.

classes.name: RootCanvas
classes.description: Main SwiftUI view managing onboarding, gateway status, and user interface.

classes.name: HomeCanvasPayload
classes.description: Data structure for rendering home canvas status information.

classes.name: HomeCanvasAgentCard
classes.description: Represents individual agent badge information in the UI.

classes.name: CanvasContent
classes.description: Subview managing the main canvas content including toolbar and overlays.

classes.name: CameraFlashOverlay
classes.description: View overlay to show camera flash effect with nonce-based animation.

methods.name: startupPresentationRoute
methods.description: Determines initial screen presentation route based on connection and onboarding states.

methods.name: shouldPresentQuickSetup
methods.description: Decides whether to present the quick setup sheet based on current app states.

methods.name: updateIdleTimer
methods.description: Enables or disables the system idle timer based on app state.

methods.name: updateCanvasDebugStatus
methods.description: Updates debug status overlay for development purposes.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Encodes current app state into JSON and updates the home canvas display.

methods.name: makeHomeCanvasPayload
methods.description: Constructs a payload object representing current connection and agent information.

methods.name: resolveActiveAgentID
methods.description: Resolves current active agent ID based on app state or defaults.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAgentID
methods.description: Returns the default agent ID for the gateway.

methods.name: homeCanvasAgents
methods.description: Generates a list of agent cards for display, highlighting active and default agents.

methods.name: homeCanvasName
methods.description: Returns the display name for an agent, normalized.

methods.name: homeCanvasBadge
methods.description: Generates badge string for an agent, with initials or emoji.

methods.name: normalized
methods.description: Trims whitespace and returns nil if empty.

methods.name: evaluateOnboardingPresentation
methods.description: Determines and shows onboarding or settings screens based on app state.

methods.name: hasExistingGatewayConfig
methods.description: Checks if there is an existing configuration for a gateway.

methods.name: maybeAutoOpenSettings
methods.description: Auto-opens the settings sheet if criteria are met.

methods.name: maybeShowQuickSetup
methods.description: Shows quick setup sheet if app state indicates.
